name: InMemoryEventStore
documentation:
An implementation of the {@link EventStoreClient} interface that provides an in-memory event storage solution. This class extends {@link InMemoryMessageStore} to inherit message store functionality and provides additional capabilities for storing, retrieving, updating, and managing aggregate event streams and relationships in memory.

It is designed for use cases where events and relationships are stored and maintained in the application memory, which makes it lightweight but volatile. The stored data will not persist beyond the lifetime of the application process and is typically used in test scenarios or for development purposes.

methods.name: resolveCurrentGraph
methods.documentation: Resolves explicitly placed current child edges for one page of root search results.

methods.name: resolveModelDocumentCollections
methods.documentation: Resolves the exact current-document collection for each requested model.

methods.name: resolveRelatedModels
methods.documentation: Resolves target model IDs from related document matches at the current relationship boundary.

methods.name: setModelCommitMaterializer
methods.documentation: Links the SDK-only event store to the direct in-memory model materializer.

methods.name: setModelGraphProjectionMaterializer
methods.documentation: Links the SDK-only event store to its in-memory search materializer.
